bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_handbag.lang_desc: yellow handbag located near the clothes hanger rod.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_bathroom cabinet.lang_desc: the bathroom counter and locate the double vanity with a mirror above it, which is the bathroom cabinet. the sink is nearby with the soap dispenser positioned towards the right. the cosmetics are placed towards the left of the sink. there is a decorative plant located between the cosmetics and the soap dispenser.

bathroom cabinet, which is a dark brown color. it is located near the bathroom counter and the sink. the cabinet is situated to the right of the sink and below the counter. additionally, you can find a decorative plant to the right of the cabinet, and a soap dispenser above it.
bathroom cabinet, a dark brown cabinet with a black mirror above it, located near the bathroom counter and the sink.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: dresser located next to the book and on the same level as the plant, vase, and curtain.
cabinet located below the mirror and to the left of the box.
small cabinet with a drawer and a shelf. it is located near the decorative plant, vase, and picture.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: blue and orange bed in the room. it is located near the blinds, pillow, toy, hanging clothes, nightstand, and plush toy.
bed in the room. the bed is located to the left of the blinds and below the end table. it is also near the pillow and the plush toy.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_table.lang_desc: table with books on it located near the handrail, box, shelf, and book.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_closet.lang_desc: walk-in closet located near the area where the hanging clothes are.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_washing machine.lang_desc: washing machine, which is described as a front-loading washer and dryer. look for it in the vicinity of the other objects. to locate it, start by finding a box positioned above a shelf. the washing machine is located between the box and the shelf.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_clothes dryer.lang_desc: the clothes dryer, which is stacked on top of the washing machine.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_bathtub.lang_desc: freestanding tub located near the shower curtain.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_bath towel.lang_desc: the bath towel located near the shower curtain and bathtub. the bath towel is a white towel with a black and white checkered pattern.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_oven and stove.lang_desc: stainless steel oven and stove located to the right of the refrigerator, above the kitchen counter, and below the microwave.

bxsVRursffK.basis.glb_sink.lang_desc: sink which is located near a mirror and a bathroom towel. the sink is described as a white pedestal sink.
